findings: Medius AB was acquired by global investment firm Marlin Equity Partners in August 2017, and subsequently received a minority investment from private equity firm Advent International on March 16, 2022, with Marlin Equity Partners remaining the majority shareholder.

Medius AB has expanded its capabilities through strategic acquisitions, including the purchase of procurement solution provider Wax Digital in November 2019, invoice payments provider OnPay Solutions in March 2022, and AI-driven expense management platform Expensya on July 25, 2023.

The company's evaluation rests on its verified ownership structure under Marlin Equity Partners and a minority equity investment by Advent International, alongside multiple completed strategic bolt-on acquisitions to build out its source-to-pay suite.
